candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Corral Valley Creek holds a genetically pure refuge population of the federally threatened Paiute cutthroat trout, translocated here in the early 1900s as part of the species' conservation program in the adjacent Silver King Creek drainage (Carson-Iceberg Wilderness). The creek is closed to all fishing all year to protect this population.

candidates.summary: Closed to all fishing all year

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license. (Note: this water is closed to all fishing all year; license requirement is noted for statewide consistency only.)
